purpose: Teach: 硫黄/料亭/銅像/寒天/紋章/紫色/食肉/露店

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと硫黄温泉に行きたいね
lines.en: Sho, I'd love to take you to a sulfur hot spring with your dad sometime.
lines.style: Warm, slightly dreamy. Soft voice like she's imagining it. Gentle emphasis on 'you' — making it about him. Trails off gently, offering rather than insisting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと料亭でお祝いしてもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to that fancy restaurant to celebrate.
lines.style: Bright and proud. Quick, eager delivery. A small child announcing something he's thought about all day. Voice lifts on the celebration — he wants her to know it mattered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、公園の銅像、誰のかな?
lines.en: Sho, do you know whose statue that is in the park?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, leaning forward slightly. Warm tone — she's not testing him, asking because she wants to know what he thinks. Open, inviting his observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの寒天大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandma's agar jellies.
lines.style: Content, matter-of-fact. The voice of a child sharing something simple and true. No performance — just stating what he likes. Small, genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼくの家の紋章、お祖父ちゃんが見せてくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa showed me our family crest at home.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Steady voice. He's sharing something he feels trusted with. Slight emphasis on 'showed me' — he was chosen to see it. Not boastful, just glad.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、紫色のクレヨンが好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like the purple crayons the best.
lines.style: Simple statement of preference. Small, uncomplicated voice. The kind of thing a six-year-old tells you just because he's thinking it. No inflection needed, just honest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、食肉だけじゃなくお野菜も食べましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we should eat vegetables too, not just meat, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact guidance. Not stern — the tone of someone who cares and is saying it plainly. Warm underneath, like she's looking out for him. Light touch, not heavy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祭りで露店のたこ焼き食べたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to eat takoyaki from the stall at the festival.
lines.style: Eager, hopeful. Slight lift toward the end — he's asking if it's possible. Quick pace, bubbling with wanting. The voice of a child who's been imagining this. Genuine excitement.
